timelines.title: Aasif, Yung and Uditi Win Their Rounds
timelines.message: Day 46 captaincy. The task is to sit on a recorder while someone else sets the speed. Mary sets Aasif slow and Qazi medium. Aasif wins and strikes Qazi and Gullu out. Qazi sets Scout fast and Yung medium. Yung wins. Scout feels dizzy and Aasif looks after him. Yung strikes Uditi and Arishfa out. Yung then sets Uditi fast and Arishfa medium. Uditi wins and strikes Scout and Yung out. Still in the race: Love, Amrapali, Mahhi, Manish, Mary, Kanika and Aasif. No captain is named.

timelines.title: Qazi Says He Will Not Speak to Mahhi
timelines.message: Day 46. Mahhi tells Qazi that Arishfa can speak for herself and that he took her side before he knew what happened. Qazi tells Uditi and Arishfa he will never speak to Mahhi again. Uditi says they cannot stay friends with Mahhi. Mahhi says she will stop sitting with him if he keeps talking to Uditi and Arishfa.

timelines.title: Six Start the Captaincy
timelines.message: Day 45. Bigg Boss puts Uditi, Arishfa, Qazi, Scout, Yung and Aasif in the captaincy. Scout tells Bigg Boss he will not support Uditi, Arishfa or Qazi. Amrapali and Love question his calls, including a captaincy chance he gave Kanika. Scout says he will play alone. In the task Qazi accuses Scout of dragging Arishfa by the leg. Aasif turns on Qazi after Qazi kicks Scout.

timelines.title: Arishfa Demands an Apology from Mahhi
timelines.message: Day 45. Qazi asks Arishfa to check his iron. She takes it as a comment on her and they fight. Mahhi steps in. Arishfa says Mahhi questioned her upbringing and wants that apology in front of the house. Mahhi says she is a single mother raising Tara and that she refused alimony. Arishfa says Mahhi is only looking for sympathy.

timelines.title: Seven Nominated in the Loser Round
timelines.message: Day 44 nomination task. Captain Scout nominates Uditi directly. In the boring round Amrapali and Manish get the most tags. In the loser round Gullu, Love, Kanika, Mary, Mahhi and Qazi tag Arishfa. Uditi tags Mary. Arishfa tags Love. Amrapali tags Gullu. The task list is Uditi, Amrapali, Manish, Arishfa, Gullu, Love and Mary. Arishfa apologises to Gullu, Kanika and Mahhi for wetting their beds. Kanika and Gullu accept.

timelines.title: Qazi and Aasif Clash Over a Heart Attack
timelines.message: Day 44. During the boring-tag round Aasif calls Qazi's step boring and tells him to act like a monkey. Qazi touches him. Aasif tells him to stay away. Qazi then pretends to have a heart attack. Aasif says he is making fun of one, and the row turns ugly. Qazi apologises. Aasif says he will talk after the task.

timelines.title: Arishfa Wets Three Beds
timelines.message: Day 43. Arishfa pours water on the beds of Kanika, Mahhi and Gullu and calls it revenge for the life she lost. Uditi refuses to join her, then says she will back her. Kanika and Mahhi confront Arishfa. Gullu wets Arishfa's bed. Mahhi calls her arrogant. Yung tells her to stop talking to him. Arishfa then asks Uditi why she has not taken a stand. The row stays verbal.

timelines.title: Scout and Yung Clash Over Plates
timelines.message: Day 43. Scout tells Yung to pick up his plate with the others. Yung says Scout is ordering him and making him feel small. Amrapali tells Scout the tone was rude, and softer than the way he speaks to Love. They talk. Scout says he did not mean an insult. Yung says he feels left out. Yung and Qazi later fight over the dishes. Qazi calls Manish fake and says he is arranging Arishfa's chaos for the cameras.

timelines.title: Aman Gandhi Evicted
timelines.message: Weekend Ka Vaar. Aman, Uditi and Mary are the bottom three. Aman has one life left. Salman says he has the fewest votes and sends him out. Arishfa breaks down. Salman says Rohit Shetty will host the next Weekend Ka Vaar.

timelines.title: Housemates Name Who Lacks a Spine
timelines.message: Weekend Ka Vaar. In the X-Ray task the house names who will not take a stand. Aman is named by Uditi, Mahhi, Kanika and Mary. Qazi is named by Arishfa, Scout, Yung and Aasif. Most of the house say Arishfa needs to use her head. Uditi names Kanika instead. Salman tells Arishfa to work on herself, and she agrees. Kanika says she will listen before she answers Arishfa. In the obsession round Mahhi gets the most tags.

timelines.title: Uditi Told She Has the Fewest Votes
timelines.message: Weekend Ka Vaar. Salman asks who changes their stand to suit themselves. Aman and Qazi are named again and again. Arishfa names Uditi, Aman and Kanika. Mary names Aman and Uditi for not standing by Arishfa in the ration task. Manish points at the whole house, and Salman tells him to speak about himself. Salman then says Uditi has the fewest votes and that he will tell her the rest later.

timelines.title: Salman Questions the Week
timelines.message: Weekend Ka Vaar. Salman goes over Nakul Dhull's eviction, praises Gullu for how he handled it, and tells the house violence is not allowed. Qazi says he did not spit in Scout's ear and that it was a joke. Salman tells Aasif he was wrong to go at Love for sitting with Nakul. Most of the house agrees. Only Aasif and Yung keep their hands down. Aasif apologises to Love. She says she does not mind. Salman also pulls up Aman for abusive language at Nakul, and Uditi for pushing the ration call instead of backing Arishfa.

timelines.title: Arishfa Destroys House Property
timelines.message: Day 40. After losing a life, Arishfa smashes Bigg Boss property and says the house punished her for a cleanliness fight, so she will leave a mess. She hides Gullu’s bottle and cup, then throws pillows when Yung takes her milk packet. Scout punishes her. Uditi says she will not defend the damage. Love takes Arishfa’s side. Aman and Yung argue. Arishfa stays in the house.

timelines.title: Arishfa Loses a Life
timelines.message: Day 40 ration task. The house has 20 minutes to agree whose life to take, and the longer they argue the more ration they lose. Arishfa gets seven votes for starting fights without a reason. She loses one life. The house gets 55 percent of the ration. She stays.

timelines.title: Mahhi and Yung Clash
timelines.message: Scout gives out duties and tells Mahhi and Yung to wash the dishes together. Mahhi tells Yung to play on the front foot before he points at other people. Yung says he will clean the washroom but will not take talk behind his back, and he keeps taunting her. Manish steps in to calm him.

timelines.title: Scout Becomes Captain
timelines.message: Day 39. Former captains each strike two housemates out of the captaincy race. Manish is kept out of it. Aasif names Love, calling her irresponsible, and Aman, saying he lacks leadership. Love objects because she gave up her own chance so Aasif could be captain. Uditi names Mary and Kanika, and says Kanika is selfish with food. Gullu names Amrapali and Arishfa, citing the ghee fight. Yung names Mahhi, calling her a backbiter, and Qazi. Scout is the new captain.

timelines.title: Aasif Questions Love Over Nakul
timelines.message: After the eviction, Love sits with Nakul and asks about his wound. Aasif says it looked bad to sit with him once the house had turned away. Qazi, Yung, Scout and Amrapali say she was wrong to approach him. Love says no one can decide whom she speaks to. The row stays verbal.

timelines.title: Nakul Dhull Evicted for Violence
timelines.message: Day 38. Nakul charges at Gullu again and the fight turns physical. The house separates them. Kanika asks Nakul to apologise. He refuses and says Gullu provoked him. Mahhi and Aasif ask Bigg Boss to evict him. Bigg Boss cites the rule against physical violence and sends Nakul Dhull out. The housemates clap. He leaves the house.

timelines.title: Nakul and Gullu Fight
timelines.message: After nominations, Qazi and Scout mock-fight and Qazi spits in Scout’s ear. Nakul tells Scout that Qazi is mocking him. The row shifts to Nakul Dhull and Gullu and turns physical. Mahhi shouts at Nakul for hitting Gullu. The house pulls them apart. JioHotstar posts the fight. No punishment is announced.

timelines.title: Nine Housemates Nominated
timelines.message: Open nominations, and a housemate can be named more than once. Aasif’s direct pick of Mahhi stands. Nominated: Yung, Mahhi, Qazi, Aman, Arishfa, Uditi, Love, Kanika and Gullu. Mary, Manish and Nakul do not nominate anyone. Scout and Qazi keep cutting each other off. Arishfa calls Mary a flipper and the two fight. Uditi and Mary clash as well. Aman nominates Scout.

timelines.title: Aasif Directly Nominates Mahhi
timelines.message: Day 36. Bigg Boss gives captain Aasif one direct nomination and says the process is limitless. Aasif names Mahhi. He says she has not followed his instructions and talks about people to her group. Mahhi says she only speaks inside her own group. The rest of the nomination list is not out.

timelines.title: Kanika and Arishfa Fight Over Ghee
timelines.message: Kanika asks captain Aasif for ghee. He says he will not play favourites with the ration. Arishfa calls her selfish and holds the bottle back. Nakul Dhull backs Arishfa. Kanika says she will not cook breakfast without it. Aasif tells Arishfa to hand it over because Kanika is going hungry. Mahhi later cries to Qazi that the food is still not being split equally.

timelines.title: Nakul Dhull Enters
timelines.message: Weekend Ka Vaar. Salman sends Nakul Dhull in as the second wildcard. Scout says he teaches chemistry and physics online and welcomes him. Love calls him her dream guy. Nakul tells Scout to keep his distance from Love. Amrapali tells Yung she does not like Nakul. Manish Goel is already in the house.

timelines.title: Aman Loses a Life and Stays
timelines.message: Salman says Mary is safe, then that Aman has the fewest votes. JioHotstar says one life is gone and the Jeevandan twist saves him. Aman stays in the house. No one leaves this weekend.

timelines.title: Salman Takes Apart the Lollipop Fight
timelines.message: Weekend Ka Vaar. Salman walks Arishfa, Kanika, Qazi, Yung, Scout and Amrapali through the lollipop argument. Qazi apologises. Salman calls the way Scout served a sick Qazi heartless. Scout apologises. Uditi says she did not know how ill Qazi was, apologises, and Qazi accepts.

timelines.title: Manish Goel Enters
timelines.message: Weekend Ka Vaar. Salman brings TV actor Manish Goel on stage as if he is promoting a project, then tells the house he is staying. He is the first wildcard. Housemates welcome him. The Sunday promo teases a second wildcard. The name is not out.

timelines.title: Qazi Wins ₹5 Lakh Style Icon
timelines.message: Salman gives Qazi Touqeer the Flipkart Style Icon award and ₹5 lakh. Kanika says she is jealous. Wamiqa Gabbi had already singled him out as the housemate she enjoys. No eviction this Saturday.

timelines.title: Salman Reviews Uditi and Gullu Splashes Water
timelines.message: Weekend Ka Vaar. Salman says the house finally showed its real side, tells Aasif and Gullu to open up, and wishes Kanika on her birthday. He questions Yung DSA and Scout. On Uditi’s captaincy, Gullu, Kanika, Mahhi and Qazi call it ‘Dimaag Ka Dahi’; Scout, Yung, Amrapali and Love call it right. Gullu is told to pour water on people he dislikes and hits Amrapali, Yung and Arishfa. Amrapali objects after her clothes get soaked. Earlier Arishfa cried after a hygiene fight and called Gullu a bully. Guests: Rannvijay Singha, Neha Dhupia, Abhishek Malhan and Prince Narula for Roadies Rebirth; Rajkummar Rao and Wamiqa Gabbi for Prahaar.

timelines.title: Aasif Becomes Captain
timelines.message: Love Gill ranks the captaincy contenders after winning the ration task. She puts herself first, Yung second, Scout third, Arishfa fourth, Aasif fifth, Uditi sixth and Kanika last. Bigg Boss offers 35% ration if she picks Kanika and 25% if she picks Aasif. Choosing herself restores nothing. She picks Aasif. He becomes captain and the house gets 25% ration.

timelines.title: Kanika and Love Clash Over the Ration Pick
timelines.message: Love and Kanika fight again after Love ranks Kanika last and gives up extra ration. Love says she wanted a captain who finds everyone beautiful. Amrapali says people who judge faces should not be captain. Qazi, feeling left out, carries a tiger statue he names Taskar. Aman, Arishfa and Uditi hide it after lights out. Love says the noise is targeting her and breaks down. Yung and Scout argue again.

timelines.title: Kanika’s Birthday in the House
timelines.message: JioHotstar 24-hour feed: the house marks Kanika Mann’s birthday. Gullu gives her a ‘Sweet 16’ compliment. Mahhi and Qazi question whether the ration is being split equally. No new captain or eviction is announced.

timelines.title: Seven Captaincy Contenders
timelines.message: Aasif hosts a three-round debate. Kanika, Love, Uditi, Arishfa, Yung and Scout win rounds and enter the captaincy race. Aasif also qualifies for running the task. Qazi and Scout’s round becomes a fight: Scout pushes Qazi and alleges that Qazi spat. Aman is pulled in. Amrapali says she never got a debate slot.

timelines.title: Gullu Brings Up Uditi’s Ex
timelines.message: Kitchen-duty fight. Uditi calls Gullu a thief. Gullu answers with a comment about her ex. Uditi breaks down. He apologises. She refuses to accept it and ignores him.

timelines.title: Week 5 Nominations
timelines.message: Mary Kom punches the nominated photos. Nominated: Qazi, Mahhi, Kanika, Aman, Love, Arishfa, Mary Kom and Gullu. Captain Uditi uses her direct nomination on Mary, saying she looks lost in the game. Safe: Uditi, Yung, Scout, Aasif and Amrapali. Yung says the house is sidelining him. Uditi and Qazi win the Style Icon promo task.

timelines.title: Uditi Breaks From Mahhi
timelines.message: Day 28. A fly on Qazi’s plate turns into a kitchen fight. Uditi says she will cook separately and change her group. Mahhi says she expected the break and regrets saving Arishfa. Arishfa tells her to nominate her next time. Scout tells Yung that Love feels like a sister, then that those feelings are changing and that Gullu’s closeness to her bothers him. Yung tells him to keep distance. Bigg Boss stops them talking in signs.

timelines.title: Mary Kom Loses a Lifeline
timelines.message: Weekend Ka Vaar, after Rhiti’s mid-week exit. Salman says the rest are not safe and warns Yung and Scout that they are on one life. Mary Kom has the fewest public votes and loses a lifeline. She stays. No second eviction this weekend.

timelines.title: Udta Teer Weekend
timelines.message: Mika Singh opens Weekend Ka Vaar and runs a Chup-sticker task. Guests: Veer Pariya, Aafiya Sayed and Nikhil Vijay for Prem Kitanu; Asha Negi and Abhay Mahajan for Ali Baba Aur 40 Bhoot; Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan for Udta Teer. Sara’s praise for Qazi irritates Kanika. The teams name an ‘Udta Teer’ in each group.

timelines.title: Salman Confronts the House
timelines.message: Weekend Ka Vaar. Salman tells Qazi he should have stopped the lollipop talk once Kanika was uncomfortable. He says the house goes quiet only before Weekend Ka Vaar and denies favouring Qazi. He corrects Arishfa for judging Mahhi by her eyes. He teases a Rhiti return, then sends the housemates back without her. Mahhi and Arishfa clash again after he leaves.

timelines.title: Rhiti Tiwari Evicted
timelines.message: First mid-week eviction. Yung, Mahhi and Uditi take Rhiti’s last lifeline and Bigg Boss asks her to leave. She says she showed her real personality. Amrapali regrets nominating her. The other Week 4 nominees stay up for the public vote. House is down to 13.

timelines.title: Uditi Becomes Captain
timelines.message: Captaincy task with Aasif as dictator. Uditi picks Aman, Yung picks Scout, Mahhi picks Qazi. They balance a ball on sticks while the house interferes. Uditi wins. Gullu starts cooking sweets from her ration to annoy her. Mary calls the new captain over-smart.

timelines.title: Uditi Calls Love’s Game Fake
timelines.message: Uditi tells Scout and Yung that Love’s closeness to Gullu is cringe and that Love’s game is fake. Love confronts her. The argument splits the groups further. Amrapali asks Scout why he still sits with people who mock their side.

timelines.title: Aman Wins Boss Meter
timelines.message: JioHotstar Boss Meter: Aman Gandhi is this week’s Boss, ahead of Gullu. This is a Boss Meter title, not house captaincy. Tonight’s promo is Love Gill vs Uditi Singh. Weekend Ka Vaar promos bring Ali Baba Aur 40 Bhoot guests.

timelines.title: Rhiti Dropped From Captaincy Race
timelines.message: Dolly Doll captaincy task. Mary Kom is dictator. Love Gill runs multiple rounds, makes Qazi break his own miniature, asks Gullu to propose to her, and saves Yung DSA. Yung, Mahhi and Uditi then vote Rhiti Tiwari out of the captaincy race. She had already lost one life.

timelines.title: Mahhi and Mary Clash Over Kitchen
timelines.message: JioHotstar highlights Mahhi’s charge that Mary Kom is playing kitchen politics over portions. Mahhi tells Aman the bias reminds her of childhood. The argument becomes a direct face-off. Arishfa and Gullu clash again after a ghee-on-roti complaint.

timelines.title: Gullu Stays in Captaincy Race
timelines.message: Housemates judge Gullu’s last captaincy with roses. Black roses from Aman, Mahhi, Amrapali, Arishfa and Uditi. Red roses from Scout, Kanika, Rhiti, Qazi and Yung. Gullu still takes the captaincy-contender spot. Bigg Boss shows the messy house and the group cleans up. Rain interrupts the next round.

timelines.title: Love and Yung Keep Distance
timelines.message: Day 24. Love and Yung agree to step back after both feel left out. Mahhi breaks down to Arishfa and Uditi over Mary’s food comments. Kanika and Qazi fight after his jokes. JioHotstar promo: Mahhi believes Mary is doing kitchen politics.

timelines.title: Ration Task Turns Violent; Mary Kom Slips
timelines.message: Aggressive ration/captaincy task. Contestants clash over food. Mary Kom slips and falls. Love Gill explodes at Yung DSA. Qazi-Yung fight continues. Mahhi and Uditi win a ration round. Bigg Boss flags rule breaks by Gullu, Yung and Mary. Season still ongoing.

timelines.title: Gullu Restores Two Lifelines
timelines.message: Captain Gullu is offered 120% ration with no lifeline restore, or 80% ration plus restoring two lives. He chooses 80% ration and restores Uditi Singh and Kanika Mann’s lost lifelines.

timelines.title: Week 4 Pair Nomination: 11 in Danger
timelines.message: Pairs must pick who gets nominated. Mahhi nominates herself to save Arishfa. Scout nominates himself to save Aasif. Aman-Kanika, Qazi-Uditi, and Yung-Love-Mary fail to agree, so all of them go up. Safe: Gullu, Arishfa, Aasif. Nominated: Rhiti, Amrapali, Mahhi, Scout, Qazi, Uditi, Aman, Kanika, Yung DSA, Love Gill, Mary Kom.

timelines.title: Isha Rikhi Evicted
timelines.message: Weekend Ka Vaar Day 21. Isha and Yung DSA were Week 3 nominees. Salman teases Yung’s exit, then reveals Isha got fewer public votes. Second full eviction after Rohed. Salman: ‘Well played, Isha. You kept your dignity.’ House now at 14.

timelines.title: Star-Studded Weekend Ka Vaar
timelines.message: Ajay Devgn and Jaideep Ahlawat promote Drishyam: The Conclusion. Fatima Sana Shaikh, Raghubir Yadav and Mohammed Zeeshan Ayyub promote Hunkkaar. Salman slams paparazzi and AI deepfake video creators. Rhiti Tiwari breaks down; Mahhi and Kanika console her.

timelines.title: Gullu Wins Captaincy Again
timelines.message: Second straight captaincy for Kushal Tanwar aka Gullu, beating Mary Kom and Love Gill. Captaincy task is physical and messy. Qazi vs Yung DSA fight. Rhiti is knocked out of the race. Arishfa vs Kanika tension continues.

timelines.title: Rhiti Loses House Support
timelines.message: Rhiti struggles to gather backing for captaincy. Gullu’s group prefers Mary Kom. Pair captaincy rounds eliminate Rhiti. Qazi later apologizes to Yung for hurting him; Yung rejects it and the fight resumes.

timelines.title: Rohed Khan Evicted
timelines.message: First full walk-out of the season. Rohed, Aasif and Scout were directly nominated after discussing nominations with Yung. Public votes send Rohed out on Day 14. Aasif and Scout survive.

timelines.title: Gullu Becomes Week 2 Captain
timelines.message: White Room captaincy: men in white, women throw colour at men they do not want as captain. Least-painted Gullu wins. Scout loses a lifeline in the process. Yung’s first captaincy ends.

timelines.title: Nominations Voided After Rule Break
timelines.message: Housemates nominate in Room 20, then Bigg Boss cancels those names. Aasif, Rohed and Scout are directly nominated for discussing nominations with captain Yung DSA. Yung is spared because he is outgoing captain.

timelines.title: Uditi Loses a Lifeline, Not the House
timelines.message: First Weekend Ka Vaar. Uditi Singh gets the fewest votes among Kanika, Arishfa, Love and Uditi. Tathas-two twist: she is not evicted; she burns one of two lives. Salman tells her the show is not for staying quiet. Amrapali–Arishfa clash continues on stage.

timelines.title: Yung DSA Named First Captain
timelines.message: Movie Theatre popcorn task. Housemates dump popcorn into buckets of Aasif, Gullu or Yung. Yung DSA wins first captaincy. Mahhi is sanchalak.

timelines.title: 2X Room Steals Lifelines
timelines.message: Captain nominees enter Room 2X. Door 2 would add a life; Door X removes one. All three must take a life: Aasif takes Arishfa’s, Gullu takes Uditi’s, Yung takes Kanika’s. Because Yung then wins captaincy, Kanika is confirmed down one life.

timelines.title: First Nominations
timelines.message: Open-style nominations. Final danger list: Kanika Mann, Uditi Singh, Arishfa Khan, Love Gill. Love gets the most names. Arishfa fights Amrapali after being called a ‘kid’.

timelines.title: Kanika’s First Power Play
timelines.message: Bigg Boss asks Kanika to name the housemate she dislikes most. She picks Qazi Touqeer. Qazi is barred from the captaincy task and made sanchalak of Happy Birthday Bigg Boss cake task. Aasif, Gullu and Yung qualify for captaincy.

timelines.title: House Settles In; Duality Theme Live
timelines.message: Wonderland house in Film City: teapot throne, BB Food Truck kitchen, shark pool, Room 20 and secret Room 2X. Every contestant starts with two lives (Vardaan / Tathas-two). Fake first-night ‘eliminate one’ joke is revealed as a prank.

timelines.title: 16 Contestants Enter
timelines.message: Confirmed house: Kanika Mann, Aasif Khan, Qazi Touqeer, Isha Rikhi, Amrapali Dubey, Rohed Khan, Mary Kom, Yung DSA (Harsh Machare), Love Gill, Tanmay ScoutOP Singh, Arishfa Khan, Aman Gandhi, Uditi Singh, Rhiti Tiwari, Kushal Gullu Tanwar, Mahhi Vij.

timelines.title: Fans Ka Faisla: Love In, Rhiya Out
timelines.message: Love Gill beats Rhiya Ahir in the pre-premiere fan vote and enters. Rhiya is eliminated on launch night without entering the main house.

timelines.title: Bigg Boss 20 Grand Premiere
timelines.message: Salman Khan hosts Season 20 (Tathas-two / Tathastu) on JioHotstar at 9 PM and Colors TV at 10:30 PM. Chess metaphor for strategy. He performs hit songs. Theme: two lives, Extra Jeevan Daan, hidden Room 20. Digital-first 20th-anniversary season launched with other language editions the same weekend.
